lines.text_en: Good afternoon. Do you have a booking?
lines.translation_ru: Добрый день. У вас есть бронь?

lines.text_en: Yes, my booking was for two nights. The name is Ivanov.
lines.translation_ru: Да, моя бронь была на две ночи. Фамилия Иванов.
accepted: Yes, my booking was for two nights.
My booking was for two nights. The name is Ivanov.

lines.text_en: I found it. A single room, breakfast included?
Yes. Was breakfast included in the price?
lines.translation_ru: Да. Завтрак был включён в цену?
accepted: Yes. Was breakfast included in the price?

lines.text_en: It was, yes. Here is your key — room 305, third floor.
lines.translation_ru: Да, был включён. Вот ваш ключ — номер 305, третий этаж.

lines.text_en: Thank you. What time is breakfast?
accepted: Thank you. What time is breakfast?

lines.text_en: Excuse me, I have a problem with my room.
lines.translation_ru: Извините, у меня проблема с номером.
accepted: Excuse me, I have a problem with my room.
I have a problem with my room.

lines.text_en: The room was dirty, and the wifi didn't work.
lines.translation_ru: Номер был грязный, и вайфай не работал.
accepted: The room was dirty, and the wifi didn't work.

lines.text_en: I'm sorry about that. We will clean it right away.
lines.translation_ru: Приношу извинения. Мы уберём сразу же.

lines.text_en: Do you have a bigger room?
accepted: Do you have a bigger room?

lines.text_en: We did have one on the fifth floor. I will move you there.
lines.translation_ru: У нас был один на пятом этаже. Я вас переселю туда.
